MTWC91495W.desc: The Indesit MTWC91495W (MyTime) is a 9kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with MyTime quick programmes that complete a full cycle in under an hour, plus cottons, synthetics, wool and delicates cycles. A energy rated.
features: MyTime — full cycles under an hour

IMA764 MyTime.desc: The Indesit IMA764 MyTime is a 7kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with five rapid cycles each under an hour and Steam Assistance to reduce creases. Quiet inverter motor. A energy rated, 10-year parts warranty.
features: Five rapid cycles under an hour

IMA864 MyTime.desc: The Indesit IMA864 MyTime is an 8kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with Push&Go one-touch starting, six quick programmes under 59 minutes and Steam Assistance. A quick wash runs in just 15 minutes. A energy rated.

IP1146.desc: The Indesit IP1146 (Push&Go) is a large 11kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with Push&Go Steam technology, five quick programmes under an hour and a Fast Mode that cuts wash time by up to 50%. 15 programmes. A energy rated.
features: Fast Mode — up to 50% shorter washes
Five quick cycles under an hour

IP946 Push & Go.desc: The Indesit IP946 Push&Go is a 9kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with one-touch Push&Go operation, a steam boost to cut creases, five rapid sub-hour cycles and an Express 14 for small loads. A energy rated.
features: Five rapid cycles under an hour

WED665WCS.desc: The Miele WED665 WCS is an 8kg 1400-spin washing machine in white with Miele's TwinDos automatic two-phase liquid detergent dispensing for perfect dosing every wash. Very quiet (50dB wash) and built to Miele's durability standards. A energy rated.

WMA1280MBL.desc: The Nordmende WMA1280MBL is an 8kg 1200-spin washing machine in matt black with 15 programmes, a 15-minute quick wash, half-load detection and overflow protection. A energy rated, 3-year warranty.

FFB8469WVUK.desc: The Whirlpool FFB8469WVUK (6th Sense) is an 8kg 1400-spin washing machine in white. 6th SENSE sensors adapt water, energy and time to each load, and the inverter motor runs quietly and lasts. A energy rated.

WTH85225IE.desc: The Bosch WTH85225IE (Series 4) is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with AutoDry sensor drying to prevent over-drying and AntiVibration design for quiet operation. Uses the eco-friendly R290 refrigerant. A++ energy rated.

CSEH8A2LE-80.desc: The Candy CSEH8A2LE-80 (Smart Pro) is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with Sensor Dry (four dryness levels), a 45-minute rapid programme and NFC app connectivity. A++ energy rated, 10-year parts guarantee.

EDHI618WD.desc: The Electrolux EDHI618WD is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with GentleCare drying at nearly half the temperature of conventional dryers and SensiCare moisture sensing that adjusts drying time automatically. Reversible door. A++ energy rated.

EDHI6285B.desc: The Electrolux EDHI6285B (DelicateCare) is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with SensiCare moisture sensing, a stainless-steel drum and gentle low-temperature drying. Anti-crease reverse tumble and delay start. D energy rated.

EDHI739U4B.desc: The Electrolux EDHI739U4B is a 9kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with sensor drying to stop at the chosen dryness level and an inverter motor for efficient, quiet operation. Wide programme range including Hygiene and Wool. Reversible door.
features: Hygiene, Wool & Bed Linen XL programmes

HHDD90BB.desc: The Hotpoint HHDD90 is a 9kg condenser tumble dryer in black with sensor drying, 15 drying cycles and a rapid programme. The condenser system collects moisture in a tank — no venting needed. B energy rated.

HHDD90GG.desc: The Hotpoint HHDD90 is a 9kg condenser tumble dryer in graphite with sensor drying, 15 drying cycles and a rapid programme. The condenser system collects moisture in a tank — no venting needed. B energy rated.

HHDD90WW.desc: The Hotpoint HHDD90 is a 9kg condenser tumble dryer in white with sensor drying, 15 drying cycles and a rapid programme. The condenser system collects moisture in a tank — no venting needed. B energy rated.

HHDW90WWIRE.desc: The Hotpoint HHDW90WWIRE is a 9kg heat pump tumble dryer in white using up to 77% less energy than a B-class condenser. ColdGuard lets it run in temperatures down to 0°C (garages/outbuildings), a PetHairCare steam cycle lifts pet hair, and HomeWhiz gives app control.
features: Up to 77% less energy than B-class condenser

NTSM1192SKUK.desc: The Hotpoint NTSM1192SKUK (ActiveCare) is a 9kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with heat-pump efficiency, sensor drying that stops at perfect dryness and a Crease Care option. 15 tailored programmes. A++ energy rated.

CYDC82WWGLUK.desc: The Indesit CYDC82WWGLUK is an 8kg condenser tumble dryer in white with a moisture sensor that stops the cycle when clothes are dry, two Xpress cycles (10 or 30 minutes) and an anti-crease function. No venting needed. B energy rated, 10-year parts warranty.

IDHE80WIRE.desc: The Indesit IDHE80WIRE is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in white that recycles warm air for gentle, efficient drying. Push&Go one-touch daily cycle, a Mix cycle for up to 4kg of mixed fabrics and an optional direct drain. E energy rated, 10-year parts warranty.

TDHPE10WH.desc: The Nordmende TDHPE10WH is a large 10kg heat pump tumble dryer in white with sensor drying (4 dryness levels), 15 programmes, drum-reverse anti-crease and a 1–23 hour delay start. E energy rated, 3-year warranty on registration.

TDHPE80DIX.desc: The Nordmende TDHPE80 is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in dark inox with sensor drying (4 dryness levels), 15 programmes, drum-reverse anti-crease and filter/tank indicators. E energy rated, 3-year warranty on registration.

TDHPE80MBL.desc: The Nordmende TDHPE80 is an 8kg heat pump tumble dryer in matt black with sensor drying (4 dryness levels), 15 programmes, drum-reverse anti-crease and filter/tank indicators. E energy rated, 3-year warranty on registration.

EWDK5846B.desc: The Electrolux EWDK5846B is an 8kg wash / 4kg dry washer dryer in white with a fast 1600-spin, DualCare and SensiCare load sensing, and a SteamRefresh cycle that neutralises odours and reduces wrinkles using 96% less water. D energy rated, 2-year guarantee.

H3DPS41066TAMB80.desc: The Hoover H-WASH&DRY 350 (H3DPS41066TAMB80) is a large 10kg wash / 6kg dry washer dryer in white with Wi-Fi & Bluetooth (hOn app), an Allergy Care Pro cycle removing 99.9% of allergens, and quick All-in-One '49 and Quick 15 cycles. Eco-Power inverter motor. D (wash&dry) / A (wash) rated.

HBWR496B8G-80.desc: The Hoover Pro Wash&Dry Series 3 (HBWR496B8G-80) is a 9kg wash / 6kg dry washer dryer in graphite with Wi-Fi & Bluetooth (hOn app, 60+ cycles), a full wash in 59 minutes, sensor control and steam for easy ironing. Anti-bacterial drawer and gasket. D (wash&dry) / A (wash) rated.

BIWDIL861485UK.desc: The Indesit BIWDIL861485UK is an 8kg wash / 6kg dry integrated washer dryer, built in behind a cabinet door. Push&Go starts a wash-and-dry with one button, and a 45-minute 30°C cycle or Express 60 gets clothes washed and dried fast. 16 programmes. D energy rated, 10-year parts.

EWDE861483SUK.desc: The Indesit EWDE861483 is an 8kg wash / 6kg dry washer dryer in silver with a Wash&Dry '45 cycle, ThermoSpin faster drying and Water Balance+ saving up to 50% water. Quiet inverter motor, 16 programmes. C energy rated, 10-year parts.
features: Water Balance+ — up to 50% water saving

EWDE861483WUK.desc: The Indesit EWDE861483 is an 8kg wash / 6kg dry washer dryer in white with a Wash&Dry '45 cycle, ThermoSpin faster drying and Water Balance+ saving up to 50% water. Quiet inverter motor, 16 programmes. C energy rated, 10-year parts.
features: Water Balance+ — up to 50% water saving

IDMA8564 MyTime UK.desc: The Indesit IDMA8564 MyTime is an 8kg wash / 5kg dry washer dryer in white with Push&Go one-touch daily cycles and a Quick 5 set of rapid programmes (from Express 15 to Full Load 59'). Quiet inverter motor. A-rated wash.
